notes: Read SKILL.md, CHANGELOG.md and all 34 files under references/ (including _contributing.md, _sections.md, _template.md) in full. The skill is a Supabase-maintained catalogue of Postgres rules (indexes, pooling, RLS, schema design, locking, pagination, monitoring), each with incorrect/correct SQL examples.

Guidance only shapes SQL the agent writes for the user's own database; no shell commands, installs, credentials, or network fetches. Examples include state-changing DDL/DML (ALTER SYSTEM, DROP TABLE on old partitions, DELETE cascade, REVOKE) presented as illustrative patterns, not instructions to run against a live database.

Minor inconsistencies: SKILL.md frontmatter says version 1.1.1 while CHANGELOG.md runs to 1.6.0 with repeated entries; the description mentions pg_cron, pgmq, pgvector and pg_restore but no reference file covers them. references/_contributing.md is contributor guidance (mentions `pnpm test`) and is not needed at runtime. security-privileges.md:42 uses placeholder password 'xxx'.
